patch.title: Naugatuck Avenue: Connecticut Selects 200 MW Jupiter Power Storage Proposal
patch.description: Connecticut selected Jupiter Power’s 200 MW Naugatuck Avenue battery project in its December 2024 solicitation. Selection begins contract negotiations; it does not establish construction, a $240 million budget or an opening date.
patch.longFormSummary:
• DEEP identifies Jupiter Power as developer and 200 MW as selected storage capacity, correcting the former Key Capture attribution and unverified $240 million budget.
  • The next procurement step is contract negotiation; the selection does not prove construction or commercial operation.

patch.title: Okolona Solar: Proposed Up to 145 MW in Chickasaw County
patch.description: NextEra describes Okolona Solar as a proposed up-to-145 MW project in Chickasaw County, Mississippi, targeting operations as early as August 2028 subject to permits and approvals.
patch.longFormSummary:
• The operator’s proposed 145 MW project is in Chickasaw County. A conflicting preliminary EIA row naming Henderson County is not substituted for the operator’s site identity.
